name: rgm
description: The RGM bug hub, for coding agents: the tester's report, its translation, the screenshots, a way to ask when the report is unclear, and a way to hand the fix back for verification.

plugins.name: rgm
plugins.description: Work a project's bugs from a coding agent: list them, read one, pull its screenshots, ask the reporter, comment what changed, and mark it fixed with the test that proves it. Bundles the rgm MCP server, the bug-intake skill, and the rgm CLI.
